title: Importing and Viewing Datasets for Data Preprocessing

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂課。

cues.en: In this one we're gonna learn how to import the dataset.
cues.zh: 這堂課要學習匯入資料集。

cues.en: Okay, so here I am on R, and as for Python, we need to set the working directory.
cues.zh: 現在我在 R 裡，和 Python 一樣，需要先設定工作目錄。

cues.en: So to do this, we have to go to Files here.
cues.zh: 點這裡的 Files。

cues.en: Here I'm on my desktop.
cues.zh: 目前在桌面。

cues.en: So let's go to our folder, Data Pre-Processing Part 1.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 1 Data Preprocessing 資料夾。

cues.en: Here it is, Section 2.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Section 2。

cues.en: And this is the right folder that contains the dataset, data.csv.
cues.zh: 這就是包含 Data.csv 資料集的正確資料夾。

cues.en: So this is the folder that you want to choose to set as working directory.
cues.zh: 應該把這個資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: And now to set this working directory on R, you need to do one more thing.
cues.zh: 在 R 裡設定，還要多做一個動作。

cues.en: You need to click on this More button here and click on Set as Working Directory.
cues.zh: 點 More，再選 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: And here it is, now we know that this is the right working directory and we are ready to start importing the dataset.
cues.zh: 好了，現在工作目錄正確，可以開始匯入資料。

cues.en: Okay, so to do this in R, what we need to do is very simple.
cues.zh: 在 R 裡，做法非常簡單。

cues.en: We will just need one line of code.
cues.zh: 只需要一行程式。

cues.en: So as in Python, we're gonna call it dataset.
cues.zh: 和 Python 一樣，把變數命名為 dataset。

cues.en: So that's the variable that will be the dataset itself.
cues.zh: 它會用來保存資料集本身。

cues.en: And now to import a dataset is very easy.
cues.zh: 匯入資料非常容易。

cues.en: You need to type read.csv.
cues.zh: 輸入 read.csv。

cues.en: And then in parenthesis, you just type the name of your dataset in quotes.
cues.zh: 再在括號中，用引號包住資料集名稱。

cues.en: So here you had to type "data.csv" And that's it, that's all you need to do.
cues.zh: 這裡填入 Data.csv，就完成了，只需要這樣。

cues.en: So now we're gonna select this line of code and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行程式並執行。

cues.en: Okay, so let's have a look at our dataset.
cues.zh: 來看看資料集。

cues.en: To do this, you just need to click here on the dataset and it just displays here.
cues.zh: 只要點一下這裡的 dataset，就會顯示出來。

cues.en: Okay, so we have our four columns, Country, Age, Salary, Purchased, and our 10 observations.
cues.zh: 四個欄位是 Country、Age、Salary、Purchased，共十筆觀測值。

cues.en: And what's interesting to see here is that, unlike Python, indexes don't start at zero, but at one.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，R 和 Python 不同，索引不是從 0，而是從 1 起算。

cues.en: So that's why the first observation start at one here and ends at 10.
cues.zh: 所以第一筆觀測值的編號是 1，最後是 10。

cues.en: So that's the second distinction you have to understand between Python and R.
cues.zh: 這是 Python 與 R 另一個需要理解的差異。

cues.en: Of course, you don't have to program on both, you can choose the one you prefer.
cues.zh: 當然，不必兩種語言都學，可以選自己喜歡的。

cues.en: But if you want to program on both, as I usually do, it's good to have this distinction in mind.
cues.zh: 但如果和我一樣，兩種都使用，就要記得這個差別。

cues.en: Okay, so we have our dataset, it's all fine.
cues.zh: 現在資料集已經準備好。

cues.en: And as I just said, here we don't have to make the distinction between a matrix of features and a dependent viable vector.
cues.zh: 如前所述，這裡不需要另外拆成特徵矩陣與依變數向量。

cues.en: And this will make perfect sense for you as we go along with this Part 1 Data Pre-Processing.
cues.zh: 隨著第一部分資料前處理的進度，你會理解原因。

cues.en: You'll perfectly understand why in next tutorials.
cues.zh: 之後幾堂課會清楚說明。

cues.en: Okay, so that's it for the importing the dataset step of the data pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 這就是資料前處理階段，匯入資料集的步驟。

cues.en: So that's it for this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next one, which will be to learn how to take care of missing data.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂課見，我們會學習處理遺漏資料。

cues.en: Because sometimes your dataset will contain missing data and you have to take care of this and that's what we're gonna learn in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 因為資料集有時會有遺漏值，必須妥善處理，下一堂課就要學這件事。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you there.
cues.zh: 期待到時見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
